subject: Acme — Pricing estimate & next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme — Pricing estimate & next steps

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the ask we agreed on: 

Summary of what we heard
- Monthly baseline: ~350M tokens (text generation + light few-shot).
- Peak traffic: up to ~1B tokens/month during product launches.
- Embeddings: roughly 10% of total token volume, used for search/semantic matches.
- SLA: 99.9% target for production endpoints; occasional bursts are expected.

Budget / target economics
- You mentioned a target range of $500–$800 per 1M tokens. For modeling purposes I used a target of $700/1M as a midpoint; open to adjusting if you prefer the low or high end.

What I attached
- Acme_Redwood_Pricing_20270120.xlsx — tiered pricing & volume discount model (monthly tiers, reserved commit options).
- token_cost_breakdown.pdf — unit economics: model inference cost, infra, caching savings, and estimated margins.

Initial recommendation & ask
- For your baseline (350M/mo) we show a blended rate of $780/1M with on-demand hosting; with a 12-month committed Reserved plan the blended goes to ~$620/1M.
- If you can confirm a 12-month commit and expected average monthly tokens (350M vs 500M), I can send a formal invoice estimate and a version tailored to a 12-mo commit vs on-demand.

Next steps
1) Confirm expected average monthly tokens (350M is our working number) and whether embeddings volume will grow beyond 10%.
2) Who is the procurement/contact that will accept a PO? You mentioned looping procurement — please share the contact and billing requirements.
3) I will produce a formal invoice estimate + per-line cost breakdown (see attached).

Thanks — happy to hop back on a 30m to walk through the spreadsheet.

—
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme — Pricing estimate & next steps

Thanks Sean — good recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed volumes: baseline 350M tokens/mo, expected peak up to 1B during launches (as you noted).
- Embeddings: currently ~10% but could grow to ~15% if we increase similarity searches.
- Budget: internal target range is $500–$800/1M tokens; procurement will push for the low end but product prefers stability.

Procurement is looped on this thread (procurement@acme.com) — they will need a one-page cost summary plus a line-item invoice with payment terms. Our typical contract terms are Net 30; please include that in the estimate.

Request: can you send an invoice-style estimate that: 1) shows blended $/1M at baseline and peak, 2) shows a 12-month committed discount scenario, and 3) includes a breakdown of model cost vs infra vs support/ops and any reserved capacity setup fees?

If you can get that to us by EOD tomorrow, procurement will review and we can route internally for approval.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Product | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-4332

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme — Pricing estimate & next steps

Alex / Procurement team — attaching the formal invoice-style estimate per your ask. Summary below and the attached PDF/Spreadsheet break out line items.

Attached:
- Invoice_Estimate_Acme_20270122.pdf (formal estimate for baseline & peak scenarios)
- Acme_Redwood_Pricing_20270120.xlsx (tiered pricing + reserved plan options)
- token_cost_breakdown.pdf (detailed unit economics)

Quick summary (all numbers shown as $ per 1M tokens unless noted)
- On-demand (no commit): blended $780/1M at 350M/mo baseline; $720/1M at 1B peak volumes (volume-driven tiering).
- 12-month Reserved (commit to 350M/mo average): blended $620/1M (includes 15% reserved discount + caching benefits).
- Add-ons: Dedicated GPU pool for burst capacity — one-time setup fee $12,000 + $0.05 per 1k tokens when used.
- Embeddings: priced at a 60% discount to generation tokens in the model (reflects lower compute per token).
- Payment terms: Net 30 (per your request).

Line-item breakdown included in PDF:
- Model inference (per-token)
- GPU infra amortized + ops 
- Cache & batching savings (credit applied)
- Support/Monitoring (monthly fee optional)

Next steps:
1) If procurement is happy with Net 30 and the baseline numbers, confirm the billing contact and we will generate a PO-ready invoice.
2) If you want a 12-month commitment quote for 500M/mo instead of 350M, I can rerun the model and provide the adjusted blended rate (likely down to ~$560/1M).
3) When you confirm, I'll spin up the standard SOW/term sheet and a DocuSign draft (link below).

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/preview/ACME-2027-SEA-01
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-SEA-01

Let me know if you want a short call to walk through the spreadsheet line-by-line — happy to schedule 30m this week.

—
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
